tagline: 3CX, Bitrix24 and IT support for Cambodian businesses
positioning: One local provider for communications, CRM, cybersecurity, hosting, infrastructure, hardware and support.
description: KHCOLO is a Cambodia-based IT and telecom partner. We license, deploy and support 3CX phone systems, Bitrix24 CRM, cybersecurity, backup, hosting and IT maintenance for businesses across Cambodia.

partners.scope: Hosted and on-premise phone systems, call centers and omnichannel deployment.
CRM, projects and contact-center workspace, implemented locally and connected to 3CX.
Cloud and appliance PBX systems and gateways.
IP phones, video conferencing and headsets.
Managed web hosting and server administration.
Endpoint security licensing, activation and renewals.

principles.title: Local engineers
principles.body: You talk to engineers based in Cambodia, in Khmer or English, not an overseas ticket queue.

principles.title: Implementation and ongoing support
principles.body: The team that designs your environment is the team that answers when something needs attention.

principles.title: Coordinated services
principles.body: Phone system, CRM, security, email and hosting from one provider, so there are no handoffs between vendors.

principles.title: Proactive maintenance
principles.body: Preventive checks and reporting catch problems early instead of waiting for them to become outages.

solutionGroups.name: Communications
solutionGroups.summary: Phone systems, CRM and meeting rooms that work together.
solutionGroups.need: Answer every customer and keep every conversation on record.

solutionGroups.name: Security & Backup
solutionGroups.summary: Endpoint protection, certificates and recoverable backups.
solutionGroups.need: Protect devices, data in transit and the files you can't afford to lose.

solutionGroups.name: Cloud & Infrastructure
solutionGroups.summary: Hosting, virtualization and private business email.
solutionGroups.need: Run websites, servers and email on infrastructure you control.

solutionGroups.name: Managed IT
solutionGroups.summary: Preventive maintenance and support for servers, PCs and networks.
solutionGroups.need: Keep everyday IT healthy with a team that already knows your setup.

notes: Partner relationships are as published on the About page (3CX Gold Partner, Yeastar Certified Reseller, Yealink Authorized Reseller, cPanel Hosting Partner) plus ESET reseller and Acronis services described elsewhere. Confirm each status before launch.
24/7 support is advertised on the current site. It is not used on the new site until the owner confirms which contracts and services it covers.
No street address, office hours or map coordinates were published. LocalBusiness markup is deliberately omitted until confirmed.

Logo is redrawn as vectors from the original colour artwork on khcolo.com: navy letters (#001088) and the blue globe with its diagonal gloss. Owner to supply original vector artwork if available, and confirm the colours.
Bitrix24 appears in the partner strip as "CRM implementation" (what KHCOLO does). If KHCOLO holds an official Bitrix24 partner status, update the wording to that exact tier.
